summary: The note describes how Chakravarti Rajagopalachari, after becoming the first Indian-born Governor General of India, chose to live in a few rooms of Rashtrapati Bhavan. Those rooms are now the President's family wing. He converted the former Viceroy's apartments into the Guest Wing, where visiting heads of state stay in India.
one_line: Chakravarti Rajagopalachari's choice of residence and conversion of the Viceroy's apartments at Rashtrapati Bhavan into a guest wing.
key_facts: Chakravarti Rajagopalachari assumed office as the first Indian-born Governor General of India.
Rajagopalachari became the occupant of Rashtrapati Bhavan when he took that office.
Rajagopalachari preferred to stay in a few rooms of the building.
The rooms where Rajagopalachari stayed are now the family wing of the President.
Rajagopalachari converted the then Viceroy's apartments into the Guest Wing.
The Guest Wing is where visiting heads of state stay while in India.
